feature: n=50 stratified delivery-confidence gate: verify all 6 quality dimensions hold at scale
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: n=50 stratified eval completes (25 buggy + 25 clean, same apachejit_test_small.csv dataset).
AC-9: Clean FP rate <= 35% (HIGH/CRITICAL on clean commits / total clean <= 0.35).
AC-10: Buggy recall >= 0.70 (HIGH/CRITICAL on buggy commits / total buggy >= 0.70).

AC-11: Report archived at .harness/evals/eval-iter-n50-delivery.json with D1-D6 and comparison vs iter-1 n=20 baseline {D1:0.60, D2:0.15, D3:0.20, D4:0.90, D5:0.37, D6:0.85} and iter-3 n=20 baseline {D1:0.900, D2:0.209, D3:0.325, D4:0.901, D5:0.600, D6:0.762}.
edge_cases: EC-1: If any gate fails at n=50 that passed at n=20, record the regression and trigger forensic analysis on failing commits before declaring the run a failure.
EC-2: If D3 < 0.20 at n=50 but was 0.325 at n=20, inspect D3=0 commits for wrong-mechanism vs judge-infra failure. Document whether the regression is within expected variance (CI at n=20 is wide).
EC-3: judge_model must be the same model (cursor-sdk) as iter-3 n=20 baseline for comparability.
verification_method: 1. Run: python -m commit_investigator.run_eval --train data/apachejit/apachejit_train.csv --test data/apachejit/apachejit_test_small.csv --zip data/apachejit/apachejit_dataset_replication.zip --max-evals 50. 2. Parse eval-report.md for D1-D6 dimension_averages. 3. Check all 6 gates pass. 4. Compute clean FP rate from stratum_averages.clean.D1 (inverted). 5. Compute buggy recall from stratum_averages.buggy.D1. 6. Archive eval-report.json to .harness/evals/eval-iter-n50-delivery.json.
